# Release Security Checklist: Secure Signing Journey

**Purpose**: Review whether the security, authority, recovery, API, UX, and evidence
requirements are complete enough to gate implementation and competition release.
**Created**: 2026-08-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Authority and Identity Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are the permissions and prohibited actions defined for operator, agent, approver, dispatcher, auditor, signer, and anonymous visitor? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Is the requirement that approval and dispatch use distinct identities unambiguous when one human holds both roles? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are authorization re-check requirements specified for membership revocation between review, approval, and dispatch? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Are existence-hiding denial semantics defined consistently for workflows and artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §US1, FR-001]

## Exact Approval Requirements

- [x] CHK005 Is every value that can materially affect provider dispatch included in the approval binding or explicitly excluded with rationale? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-010]
- [x] CHK006 Are canonicalization rules defined for Unicode, ordering, empty values, coordinates, and duplicate recipients? [Clarity, Data Model §Review Payload]
- [x] CHK007 Is the difference between invalidated, expired, consumed, and denied approval specified with irreversible state rules? [Clarity, Data Model §Approval Envelope]
- [x] CHK008 Does the restoration scenario clearly require a new nonce, review ceremony, and approval rather than reviving historical authority? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK009 Are the minimum visible mutation categories and expected reviewer explanation explicitly defined? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, SC-003]

## External-Effect Safety Requirements

- [x] CHK010 Are hard budget units, reset periods, reservation release rules, and operator override boundaries specified for each provider operation? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK011 Are concurrency and idempotency requirements defined for simultaneous multi-instance requests and mismatched request digests? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, SC-002]
- [x] CHK012 Are ambiguous timeout outcomes distinguished from confirmed pre-send failures and permanent provider failures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK013 Are retry ceilings, lease expiry, late-worker fencing, and reconciliation ownership requirements documented? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK014 Is the public fixture/live-mode boundary defined for UI, API, workers, and operator commands? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]

## Artifact and Process Boundary Requirements

- [x] CHK015 Are maximum request, PDF, parser output, child output, duration, and memory limits quantified before implementation? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, FR-007, FR-018]
- [x] CHK016 Are structural PDF acceptance and quarantine outcomes specified for encrypted, polyglot, truncated, and resource-heavy inputs? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are digest recomputation points and the consequences of each mismatch defined consistently across review, download, approval, and dispatch? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, FR-017]
- [x] CHK018 Are executable, module source, working-directory, environment, cancellation, and process-tree constraints documented as one provider-process contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]

## Foxit eSign and Webhook Requirements

- [x] CHK019 Are the exact provider identifiers needed to correlate local workflow, folder/envelope, documents, parties, events, and downloads documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK020 Are token failure, provider validation failure, rate limit, timeout, and unknown-response requirements defined without blind resend? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK021 Is raw-body signature verification defined before parsing, including encoding, query parameter bounds, constant-time comparison, and secret rotation behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK022 Are duplicate, stale, early, out-of-order, uncorrelated, cancelled, completed, and executed event dispositions specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-015]
- [x] CHK023 Is the terminal evidence point explicitly tied to `folder_executed`, with requirements for executed-document and activity-history retrieval? [Consistency, Research §Decision 6]

## Review Experience and Accessibility Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Are visual priority and plain-language explanations defined for digest, recipients, fields, findings, provenance, diff, and blocked state? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK025 Are keyboard, screen-reader, focus, contrast, reduced-motion, mobile viewport, loading, empty, and error-state requirements present for every review action? [Gap]
- [x] CHK026 Is the human confirmation ceremony specific enough to prevent accidental approval and distinguish approval from dispatch? [Clarity, Spec §US3–US4]
- [x] CHK027 Are maximum judge-journey time and first-time operator outcomes objectively measurable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, SC-007]

## Evidence, Privacy, and Operations Requirements

- [x] CHK028 Is every public claim category mapped to the minimum acceptable dated evidence and sanitization rule? [Traceability, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK029 Are private raw webhook, provider response, PDF, and diagnostic retention periods plus deletion-failure behavior defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-019, FR-021]
- [x] CHK030 Is “tamper-evident” scoped to the application trust boundary and kept consistent with all public immutability language? [Consistency, Data Model §Audit Event]
- [x] CHK031 Are evidence publication, deployment, live dispatch, and media release clearly identified as separate human-authorized gates? [Completeness, Constitution §Delivery and Evidence Gates]
- [x] CHK032 Are clean-checkout reproducibility, privacy scan, link validation, and evidence-manifest criteria defined for final release? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-008–SC-009]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK033 Are ownership requirements for Foxit webhook configuration, sandbox credentials, test signer consent, public HTTPS, and executed-document access documented? [Dependency, Assumption]
- [x] CHK034 Is the single supplier-agreement template boundary precise enough to prevent undocumented general-contract expectations? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions, Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK035 Are host, database, volume, backup, restore, and worker availability assumptions linked to measurable recovery requirements? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]

## Notes

- Initial result: 15 satisfied, 20 open. Remediation added measurable requirements
  to the canonical artifacts; re-review result: 35 satisfied, 0 open. Checked markers
  certify requirements quality only, not implementation completion.
- Resolved by Role and Ceremony, Operational Limits and Recovery, Provider Process
  and eSign, Review Experience and Accessibility, and Evidence, Retention, and Release
  requirement sections in `spec.md`, plus canonical contract and quickstart updates.

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add findings inline and link remediation to exact requirement identifiers.
